description: Verify & standardize a US address — validates deliverability and returns the USPS-standardized address, county, lat/lon, ZIP+4, and residential/commercial indicator. Example: smarty_verify_address({ street: "1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy", city: "Mountain View", state: "CA", _apiKey: "authId:authToken" })

_apiKey.description: Smarty credentials as "authId:authToken" (server key pair), or a single embedded/website key. Free account + 1000 lookups at smarty.com

city.description: City name (optional if included in street)

street.description: Street address, or a full freeform US address, e.g. "1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy" or "1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA 94043"

name: smarty_verify_address
title: Smarty Verify Address
